description: This PHP source file defines the AuthenticationException class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically in the Authentication\Exception namespace. It encapsulates various static methods to generate specific authentication-related exceptions, such as invalid credentials, session expiry, and user account issues, with localization support via the I18NHelperTrait.
